metadata.status: source-reviewed named genealogy, excludes unknown/unverified family claims; not an assertion that all ever-named peripheral relatives are exhaustively represented
metadata.coverage: Known named Targaryen dynasty and closely connected families from Aenar of Dragonstone to Daenerys, selected named Blackfyre descendants and marriages; incomplete for unknown/unlisted descendants.
metadata.important: Contains full-series spoilers. Do NOT silently treat in-world rumors, speculative parentage, or show-only facts as canonical biological parents.

book.title: The World of Ice & Fire: The Untold History of Westeros and the Game of Thrones
book.description_uk: Ілюстрований довідник до світу «Пісні льоду й полум’я». Тестовий набір персонажів охоплює підтверджені зв’язки дому Таргарієнів та споріднених династій із книжкового канону, включно з матеріалами інших творів циклу.

exclusions.reason: R+L=J remains a theory in published novels; canon confirmed on television only; no parent-child import.
Laenor Velaryon is publicly recognized as father, biological paternity disputed. Do not assert Laenor or Harwin Strong as biological father.
No invented identities; retain only documented named persons. Some unknown children omitted; do not equate absent with nonexistence.
Claim to be Rhaegar’s son Aegon is disputed; do not create independent verified parentage or duplicate Aegon under a new identity.
Family tree projection currently shows family-category spouses; do not reclassify romantic partner_of as family.
